headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 14, 2026**
article:
The Baltimore Orioles made two significant moves, transferring left-handed pitcher Keegan Akin to the 60-day injured list due to left elbow discomfort and acquiring right-handed pitcher Cam Sanders from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash. 

Several players have been placed on the injured list, affecting their teams' lineups and rotations. The Arizona Diamondbacks' Zac Gallen was placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 9, 2026, due to right elbow inflammation. The Texas Rangers' Chris Martin was placed on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder impingement. The Cincinnati Reds' Nick Lodolo was placed on the 15-day injured list due to a blister on his left index finger. The Miami Marlins' William Kempner was placed on the 15-day injured list with a right elbow sprain. The Milwaukee Brewers' Brandon Woodruff was transferred to the 60-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation. The Atlanta Braves' Mike Yastrzemski was placed on the 10-day injured list with left elbow inflammation. The Minnesota Twins' Anthony Banda was transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left lat strain.

The trade market has been active, with several teams making moves to bolster their rosters. The Baltimore Orioles acquired Cam Sanders from the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The Milwaukee Brewers traded for Houston Astros' shortstop Braden Shewmake. The Chicago White Sox traded LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins acquired RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations.
